column1: # What Advanced Map adds to RuneLite's agility shortcuts (net.runelite.client.game.AgilityShortcut): where the map's icon
# is, when RuneLite places it where the game's own world map draws the dungeon elsewhere, and what else it needs.
# Places are the icon's tile on Advanced Map's map, as the owner saw it in game; needs are from the OSRS Wiki. A need's
# varbit (net.runelite.api.gameval.VarbitID) is 1 once the player has it: the line is green then, red until.
# shortcut (RuneLite's name), x, y (empty: RuneLite's place), needs (empty: nothing more), varbit (empty: only told)
